name: @tanrei/docs
description: Tanrei documentation site (Astro Starlight; English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic).

scripts.dev: node ../../packages/tools/src/font-faces.js src/styles/fonts.generated.css --icon-glyphs ../../packages/web/src/generated/glyphs.json,src/generated/glyphs.json --full-icons src/styles/icons-full.generated.css && node scripts/fixture-documents.mjs && astro dev
scripts.validate: node scripts/i18n-check.mjs && node scripts/fixture-documents.mjs && astro check --minimumFailingSeverity warning
scripts.build: node ../../packages/tools/src/font-faces.js src/styles/fonts.generated.css --icon-glyphs ../../packages/web/src/generated/glyphs.json,src/generated/glyphs.json --full-icons src/styles/icons-full.generated.css --check-systems && node scripts/fixture-documents.mjs && astro check --minimumFailingSeverity warning && astro build
scripts.test: pnpm test:node && node ../../packages/tools/src/font-faces.js src/styles/fonts.generated.css --icon-glyphs ../../packages/web/src/generated/glyphs.json,src/generated/glyphs.json --full-icons src/styles/icons-full.generated.css --check-systems && astro build && pnpm test:browser
